topic: Picking Up a Custom Birthday Cake

script.title: THE BIRTHDAY CAKE PICKUP
script.story_hook: A pickup, a pink box, one letter out of place.
script.intro_zh: 取蛋糕、粉盒子，卻少了一個正確的字母。
script.welcome_en: Hi everyone! Today we pick up a custom birthday cake.
script.welcome_zh: 大家好！今天到烘焙坊領取客製生日蛋糕。
script.outro: Birthdays saved by a little English. Practice away!
script.outro_zh: 一點英文就能救回一場生日派對，快去練習吧！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's say it all together, line by line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起，一行一行說出來。

預定的生日蛋糕要去取了，名字卻拼錯怎麼辦？這集 18 句烘焙坊對話教你報訂單名字、確認取件時間、請店家改名、索要蠟燭與檢查付款狀態。自然美式口語搭配繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就能安心把蛋糕帶回家。

script.youtube_description_en:
Your custom cake is ready, but the name on top is wrong! In this 18-line bakery scene you'll learn to give your pickup name, ask about timing, get the lettering fixed on the spot, find the candles, and confirm the payment. Everyday American English with IPA, plus a repeat-after-me section so you can order with confidence.
Repeat every line in the second half and lock it in.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎂蛋糕店英文｜報取件名・修正拼字・確認付款｜聽完就會取蛋糕｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
預定的生日蛋糕，取貨時發現名字拼錯了？
派對就要開始，該怎麼請店家緊急修正？

這一集帶大家走進香氣四溢的烘焙坊，跟著顧客從報上取件名、發現拼字錯誤、請店家現場改名，到確認蠟燭與付款，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🎂 報取件名：例如「I'm here for a cake pickup under Alvarez.」
✏️ 修正錯誤：例如「It says Leo, but you ordered Leah.」、「I'll re-pipe the name right now.」
🕯️ 收尾確認：例如「Did that come with candles?」、「It's prepaid.」

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次取蛋糕，安心把最美的驚喜帶回家！
script.thumbnail_expression: wide-eyed surprise at a cake box

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm here for a cake pickup under Alvarez.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm hɪr fɔr ə keɪk ˈpɪkˌʌp ˈʌndər ælˈvɑrɛz/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我來領取下單在 Alvarez 名下的蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check... the chocolate funfetti, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə ˈtʃɑklət fʌnˈfɛti raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 讓我查一下……巧克力糖針蛋糕，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! Can we take it now? We're a bit early.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs kæn wi teɪk ɪt naʊ wɪr ə bɪt ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 對！我們現在可以拿走嗎？我們來得有點早。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost done, the lettering needs ten more minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlˌmoʊst dʌn ðə ˈlɛtərɪŋ nidz tɛn mɔr ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 快好了，字樣還需要十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's okay, we can wait in the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts oʊˈkeɪ wi kæn weɪt ɪn ðə kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 噢沒關係，我們可以在車上等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Actually, one thing here looks off to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæktʃuəli wʌn θɪŋ hɪr lʊks ɔf tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，這裡有一個地方不對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Off? What do you mean, is it the colors?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔf wʌt du ju min ɪz ɪt ðə ˈkʌlərz/
dialogue.zh: 不對？你是說顏色有問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The name, it says Leo, but you ordered Leah.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə neɪm ɪt sɛz ˈlioʊ bʌt ju ˈɔrdərd li/
dialogue.zh: 是名字：上面寫 Leo，但您訂的是 Leah。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, my daughter will notice that instantly.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ maɪ ˈdɔtər wɪl ˈnoʊtɪs ðæt ˈɪnstəntli/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，我家寶貝一定馬上就會發現。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy fix, I'll re-pipe the name right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi fɪks aɪl ri paɪp ðə neɪm raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 很好修，我馬上重新擠上名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? That would save the whole birthday, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪli ðæt wʊd seɪv ðə hoʊl ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那簡直救了整個生日派對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. There's Leah, spelled just right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are a hero. Did that come with candles?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ə ˈhɪroʊ dɪd ðæt kʌm wɪð ˈkændəlz/
dialogue.zh: 你真是大功臣。蛋糕附有蠟燭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a box of seven, inside the bag there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə bɑks ʌv ˈsɛvən ɪnˈsaɪd ðə bæɡ ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 有的，一盒七支，就在袋子裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Do I need to show a confirmation?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt du aɪ nid tə ʃoʊ ə ˌkɑnfərˈmeɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我需要出示訂單確認信嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not needed, it's prepaid. Drive careful, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈnidəd ɪts ˈpriˈpeɪd draɪ ˈkɛrfəl oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不用，已經付過款了。開車慢一點好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you so much, happy baking to you!
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju su mʌtʃ ˈhæpi ˈbeɪkɪŋ tə ju/
dialogue.zh: 太謝謝你了，祝你烘焙愉快！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy birthday to Leah! Enjoy the party.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ tə li ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə ˈpɑrti/
dialogue.zh: 祝 Leah 生日快樂！派對盡興。
